candidates.challenge_question: What specific operational protocols govern the decision to deploy when weather warnings arrive with less than the 40-minute lead time required by the model, given that the contract excludes vendor warranty coverage for city-caused deployment delays?

How will the city maintain the proposed shuttle service for the residential block if the transit agency has not yet secured or priced the necessary staffing to operate during unplanned flood closures?

What performance metrics will trigger a re-assessment of the barrier program if operational deployment realities, specifically night or surge conditions, consistently fail to match the assumptions used in the hydraulic modeling?
